query:

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL) as molecules_wikidata,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL) as molecules_pubchem,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants WHERE wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL) as plants_wikidata,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olfactive_emissions) as total_olfactive_emissions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olfactive_experiences) as total_olfactive_experiences,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storylines) as total_storylines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_elements) as total_story_elements,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recettes) as total_recettes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_materials) as total_raw_materials,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tabacs) as total_tabacs;
